BiblicalUsage: Pelaliah appears once, in a list of priests who did the work of the house: Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, among the eight hundred and twenty-two who served in Jerusalem after the return. His son Adaiah is listed among the brethren who did the work of the house, so the father’s name is kept with the priests who served.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that God records the servants by their fathers' names, and Pelaliah is remembered because his son did the work of the house.
